ops-bot: Incident created 1763004322 • Severity P1 • detected anomalous decode node restarts in decode-rt-prod (ap-southeast-1). Auto-pager triggered. Runbook: <runbooks/redwood/gpu-oom.md>

eli (oncall): I'm on it — seeing multiple node flaps and OOM traces. Initial hypothesis: runaway generation (client loop) + max_tokens header mismatch.

nina (sre): Confirmed: traffic spike with lots of long prompt loops. Telemetry shows 62% of failing requests include header X-Client-Max-Tokens > 4096 while router enforced 1024 previously — mismatch caused unbounded KV growth.

samir (infra): Attaching recent logs from decode-node-7:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:33Z [decode-node-7] ERROR kernel: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory allocating 3.2GiB
2026-03-15T02:12:35Z [decode-node-7] WARN supervisor: container restart (OOM)
2026-03-15T02:12:40Z [router] WARN eviction: KV cache size exceeded threshold -> attempting eviction
```

eli (oncall): Immediate mitigations applied: 1) tighten edge tokencap override to 1024 for decode route; 2) enable overflow routing to low-memory fallback (gpt-3.8-quant-cpu) for heavy sessions; 3) force-evict largest KV caches on affected nodes. Executed commands:
```
# edge override
rctl update --route decode-rt-prod --set header.X-Client-Max-Tokens=1024
# route overflow
router patch decode-rt-prod --fallback gpt-3.8-quant-cpu --overflow true
```

samir (infra): Throttle hotfix rolled: `service scale decode-rt-prod --max-concurrency 30` and deployed a tokencap guard in the router code to reject sessions that attempt to bump max_tokens via header aggressively.

kristen (support): Customer impact summary: approx 1.2k requests dropped across 4 paying tenants during the 18-minute window. Major customers A and C saw elevated error rates (A: 4.8%, C: 3.3%). Drafting notification: "Transient request drops due to GPU OOMs caused by runaway generation; mitigations in place; follow-up postmortem forthcoming." :memo:

eli (oncall): After tokencap + fallback routing, node restarts stopped. Error rate dropped from ~18% to ~1.6% within 8 minutes. Monitoring KV cache growth and latency.

nina (sre): Follow-ups/retrospective actions: - Add explicit router telemetry for client-supplied max_tokens vs enforced tokencap - Add auto-evict policy when mem > 75% for decode nodes - Add defensive check to reject prompt loops (identify repeated long prompt tokens from same session) - Postmortem + replay harness to reproduce KV growth.

samir (infra): Also note container image had older cuda runtime; will queue a canary upgrade to newer driver to reduce allocation fragmentation risk.

eli (oncall): Handoff to night oncall @jordan for metric collection, heap snapshots, and post-incident follow-up. Jordan, please collect pprof, KV cache histograms, and the client traffic sample for replay.

jordan (oncall-night): ack — pulling pprof and heap dumps now; will also capture top-20 sessions causing KV growth and put them into the replay bucket. Scheduling follow-up 0900 UTC to triage postmortem.

kristen (support): I've created support tickets for the affected customers and queued the draft comms for review.

eli (oncall): Tags: gpu-oom, runaway-generation, tokencap-mismatch, kv-cache-growth. Closing realtime pager once stable for 1h. Great work — keep updates in this thread for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
